library_preparation_preflight.summary: sshd-common is pure Java; SLF4J resolves transitively, while Bouncy Castle and EdDSA are optional. Meaningful coverage needs no extra dependency, Docker image, or system property.
library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: Exercise public utility APIs using temporary files and in-memory data. Avoid optional Bouncy Castle/EdDSA algorithms and user SSH configuration unless explicitly adding those providers.
risks: Native Image may require metadata for service-loaded providers or cryptographic implementations.
The module registers RootedFileSystemProvider through Java's service-loader mechanism; local native verification remains authoritative.
